player_prompt.intro:
Jani Tower of Hanoi ukatx {num_disks} wak'akaraki.
Jani wak'akax A wasanxaraktan C wasanxaraki ukhamaraki.
Jani wak'asi ukatx, jani qhipatasi wasanxarakit jani ukhamatasi wasanxarakit (saxra, '[A C]').
Jani wak'asi jani q'awasi, jani jani wak'asi ukatx jach'asi, jani jani wak'asi jani juch'asi ukhamasi.
Jupanakax p'unchayx, jani wak'asi jani ukatx.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Jumax jan wali thakhina, jani ukaxa chiqapa jach'a torre uñstaytaxa.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Mä torretajj janiw utj-cataynati. Jumajja mä disco apañwa munäyäta, ucampis jupajj chhakhapunïnwa.
invalid_move.same_tower: Jumax uka torreruw mä jisk'a disk apañ muntaxa.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Mä jach'a disk mä jisk'a disketxar uchañatakiw ch'amachastaxa.

outcome.turn_limit: T'aq'a t'aq'asiñani q'utu q'ala. Q'umir q'ala {pct}% q'ala q'ala q'utu q'ala C q'ala.
